---
title: "Intended Use and Indications"
---


## Indications for Use

The OralEye™ Imaging System provides standardized digital documentation to complement traditional clinical workflows. The system is designed to record and store digital data for baseline referencing and longitudinal monitoring.

::: {.callout-important}
## Important
The use of this system is an adjunct to, and does not replace, the standard clinical protocol.
:::

### Clinical Application

**Specifically:**

- The clinician should **always perform a traditional visual inspection** of the oral cavity, utilizing the OralEye to create a permanent digital record of the current status
- The OralEye is a **documentation tool** for record-keeping and data management
- It is **not a diagnostic device** and should not be used to override clinical findings or professional judgment derived from traditional visual inspection

::: {.callout-warning}
## Not Intended For
The OralEye™ is **not intended** for:
- Standalone detection of oral cancer
- Diagnosis of occult pathology
- Determination of surgical margins
:::

## Documentation Protocols

The OralEye™ Imaging System supports two primary documentation protocols:

### Comprehensive Record

The **Comprehensive Record** involves systematic capture of the patient's oral cavity, utilizing reflectance and fluorescence imaging across key anatomical sites.

**Purpose:**
- Establishes a stable, objective baseline of oral mucosal appearance
- Records tissue patterns creating a 'visual ledger'
- Assists clinicians in longitudinal monitoring

**Benefits:**
- Enables comparison of current images against archived records
- Facilitates tracking of visible changes over time
- Supports routine dental record-keeping
- Aids in professional consultation

**Typical Coverage:**
- Nine distinct anatomical regions
- Standardized imaging positions
- Both reflectance and fluorescence modalities

### Regional Record

The **Regional Record** is intended for standardized capture of areas with visible clinical findings.

**Purpose:**
- Records high-contrast reflectance and fluorescence images of specific sites
- Includes digital tools to document visible dimensions and shape
- Provides objective data as a 'visual ledger'

**Benefits:**
- Assists in tracking changes in site appearance over time
- Facilitates high-resolution, standardized data for referral
- Supports the referral handshake between general practitioners and specialists
- Ensures specialists receive consistent and objective data sets

**Clinical Use:**
- Focus on specific areas of concern
- Multiple captures of the same region
- Enhanced detail for specialist consultation
- Supports triage and longitudinal monitoring

## Intended Users

The OralEye™ Imaging System is intended for use by:

- Licensed dental professionals
- Trained dental hygienists
- Clinical staff under supervision of licensed practitioners

::: {.callout-note}
## Professional Use Only
This device is to be operated only by trained clinicians.
:::

## Product Classification

- **Product Code:** LMD (Camera, Dental)
- **Use Category:** Medical Communication and Documentation
- **Regulatory Classification:** Professional dental imaging device
